notes.body:
# Lease ledger

Lease recovery uses a durable lease ledger. The writer records an intent before acknowledging a renewal.
Recovery replays only committed intents; an uncommitted intent is discarded.
The repair is recorded in [[Projects/example/events/sessions/lease-repair|the repair session]].

# Lease renewal hang

The lease renewal hang followed an interrupted intent append. Replaying uncommitted intents duplicated a renewal.
The verified correction is recorded in [[Projects/example/events/sessions/lease-repair|the repair session]].

# Lease repair session

Changed replay to ignore uncommitted intents after reproducing the lease renewal hang.
The regression passed against the durable [[Projects/example/entities/lease-ledger|lease ledger]].
The originating incident is [[Projects/example/records/problems/lease-hang|the lease renewal hang]].

# Multipart transfer

Multipart transfer persists completed segment offsets in a manifest. On reconnect, a sender resumes from the last acknowledged segment instead of retransmitting the complete object.

# Checksum mismatch incident

The checksum mismatch incident affected imported CRLF manifests. Hash the original bytes before newline normalization. The byte-preservation regression passes.

# Current quorum policy

Current quorum policy requires three acknowledgements before promotion. This replaces the earlier two-acknowledgement policy.
See [[Projects/example/entities/quorum-old|the earlier quorum policy]].

# Earlier quorum policy

Earlier quorum policy required two acknowledgements before promotion. This historical policy was superseded by [[Projects/example/entities/quorum-current|the current quorum policy]].

# Блокировка журнала

Блокировка журнала при восстановлении удерживается до проверки отпечатков всех файлов. После проверки процесс удаляет временные файлы и освобождает блокировку.

# Auth policy

Auth policy requires an explicit capability before reading tenant secrets. An absent capability refuses the request.

# Authorization spelling distractor

Authorization spelling fixture with no capability requirement.

# Writer completion

flush_pending_writes synchronizes every staged file before publishing the manifest. A failed sync retains the journal for explicit recovery.

# Legacy bridge

The bridge uses a compatibility socket. Its support state is recorded only in frontmatter.

# Freshness

The accepted cache freshness window is 90 seconds. Invalidation uses the source fingerprint.
